blurb_zh: 一周里哪几个小时最忙
scene_zh: 一家街边咖啡店的时段杯数（模拟数据）

views.subject: Cups sold by day and hour
views.subtitle_en: Cups sold per hour, 8 am to 7 pm.

examples.en: The busiest cell is Sunday at 10 a.m., when the shop sells 112 cups an hour.
examples.zh: 最忙的格子是周日 10 点，每小时卖出 112 杯。

features.note_zh: peak_cell 用 the busiest cell；具体时刻前用 at。
features.interpret_zh: 单格峰值只说明这一小时，不能代表全天都忙。

examples.en: The quietest cell is Monday at 7 p.m., at just 6 cups.
examples.zh: 最冷清的格子是周一 19 点，只有 6 杯。

features.note_zh: quiet 比 empty 准确——还有少量客人。
features.interpret_zh: 最低格在工作日晚间，但图里只有杯数，没有客单价或外带比例。

examples.en: Sunday trade is packed into a midday block: 112 cups at 10 a.m. and 80 at 11 a.m.
examples.zh: 周日生意集中在中午一小段：10 点 112 杯，11 点 80 杯。

features.note_zh: be packed into + 时段，强调时间窄、密度高。
features.interpret_zh: 周末中午集中，但热力图只给每小时杯数，看不出堂食还是外带。

examples.en: Across the week, 9 a.m. is the busiest column, averaging 76 cups an hour.
examples.zh: 整周来看，9 点是均值最高的一列，每小时 76 杯。

features.note_zh: column average 是热力图的列均值；compare_periods 用来横向比时段。
features.interpret_zh: 9 点均值最高，是因为工作日和周末都在这个时段忙，不代表每天都以 9 点为首。

examples.en: Monday opens at 62 cups at 8 a.m. and fades to 6 by 7 p.m.
examples.zh: 周一从 8 点的 62 杯一路减弱，到 19 点只剩 6 杯。

features.note_zh: fade 描述热力图颜色由深转浅，数值同步下降。
features.interpret_zh: 工作日曲线单调下降，但颜色深浅是相对整张图，不能当作绝对强度。

views.overview_zh: 工作日从 8 点到 9 点的高峰一路下滑，19 点只剩个位数；周末把高峰推到 10 点到 13 点，周日 10 点的 112 杯是全周最高。热力图只给每小时杯数，不含客单价和堂食、外带结构。

general.a2: The shop is busiest at 9 a.m. on weekdays and around 10 a.m. to noon on weekends. Sunday at 10 a.m. is the peak, with 112 cups an hour. Evenings are quiet, especially on Monday.
general.b1: Weekday trade peaks at 8 to 9 a.m. and then falls steadily, dropping to 6 to 12 cups by 7 p.m. Weekends shift the peak later: Saturday is busiest at 10 a.m. and Sunday at 10 a.m. to noon, when sales reach 112 cups an hour. The quietest hour is Monday at 7 p.m., at 6 cups.
general.b2: The heatmap separates two business rhythms. Weekdays show a narrow morning peak — 62 to 72 cups at 8 a.m., falling to 6 to 12 cups by 7 p.m. — while weekends spread demand across a midday block, with Sunday reaching 112 cups at 10 a.m. Monday is the weakest day overall, averaging 32 cups an hour against Sunday's 59.

descriptions.ielts: The shop was busiest on Sunday at 10 a.m., when it sold 112 cups an hour, and quietest on Monday at 7 p.m., at 6 cups. Weekday demand peaked between 8 and 9 a.m. and declined through the day, whereas weekend sales stayed high from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m.
descriptions.business: Demand splits into two peaks: a weekday morning rush of 62 to 78 cups an hour and a weekend midday block that tops out at 112 cups on Sunday at 10 a.m. Staffing should follow that split, with the weekday 8-to-10 window and the weekend 10-to-1 window covered most heavily; Monday evening, at 6 cups an hour, is the clearest window for maintenance.

views.subject: Monthly cups sold by drink
views.subtitle_en: Cups sold per month by drink.

examples.en: Latte is the best seller, at 4,860 cups a month.
examples.zh: 拿铁最畅销，每月 4860 杯。

features.note_zh: best seller 是饮品语境里最自然的说法。
features.interpret_zh: 销量最高不等于利润最高，图里没有价格和成本。

examples.en: Americano ranks second, at 3,940 cups a month.
examples.zh: 美式排第二，每月 3940 杯。

features.interpret_zh: 美式与拿铁相差 920 杯，约少 19%。

examples.en: Mocha comes in at 1,960 cups a month.

features.note_zh: come in at + 数值，商务语境常用来报单个数字。
features.interpret_zh: 摩卡处在中段，单看数字说明不了它是新品还是常青款。

examples.en: Cold brew sells 1,420 cups a month, about half the cappuccino figure.
examples.zh: 冷萃每月 1420 杯，约为卡布奇诺的一半。

features.note_zh: about half + 名词；比较时先说对象、再说基准更清楚。
features.interpret_zh: 冷萃只有卡布奇诺的一半，但如果只在夏季主推，年度总量会低估旺季表现。

examples.en: Matcha latte is the smallest line, at 980 cups a month.
examples.zh: 抹茶拿铁是最小的一条产品线，每月 980 杯。

features.note_zh: the smallest line 用于产品线；最低值也可说 the lowest figure。
features.interpret_zh: 980 杯是六款里最少，但它可能单价更高，不能直接判定贡献最小。

views.overview_zh: 六款饮品合计每月 15,940 杯。拿铁和美式两款就占 8,800 杯，超过其余四款的总和；拿铁几乎是抹茶拿铁的五倍。杯数只反映销量，不含单价、成本和季节波动。

general.a2: Latte is the most popular drink, at 4,860 cups a month. Americano is second with 3,940, and cappuccino is third with 2,780. Matcha latte sells the least, at 980 cups.
general.b1: Latte leads at 4,860 cups a month, followed by Americano at 3,940 and cappuccino at 2,780. Sales fall steadily after the top three, down to 980 cups for matcha latte. Mocha and cold brew sit in the middle at 1,960 and 1,420.
general.b2: The menu is front-loaded: latte and americano together account for 8,800 of the 15,940 cups sold each month, more than the other four drinks combined. Cappuccino adds 2,780, while mocha, cold brew and matcha trail at 1,960, 1,420 and 980. Latte outsells matcha latte by nearly five to one.

descriptions.ielts: Latte recorded the highest monthly sales at 4,860 cups, followed by americano at 3,940 and cappuccino at 2,780. Mocha and cold brew sold 1,960 and 1,420 cups respectively, while matcha latte had the lowest figure at 980.
descriptions.business: Latte and americano carry the menu, together selling 8,800 cups a month — more than the other four drinks combined. The long tail is thin: matcha latte moves just 980 cups, a fifth of latte volume. Menu simplification around the top two is likely to protect most of the revenue, but margin data is needed before cutting anything.
